usedFor: EventBrite holds the ticket orders, and Freshsales Classic changes a deal through “Update Deal” when “New Orders” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Orders” in EventBrite, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: An order carries the sale itself, so the deal's amount and stage can follow it.

watchOut: “New Attendee Check -In” and “New Orders” both feed “Update Deal”, so one ticket can change a deal twice.
